project_type: 4A Store v2 — Node/TypeScript/Express/Prisma API (api-node) + React/Vite/TS SPA (web). Local grocery store (Bihar). Legacy static HTML/PHP at repo root is OUT OF SCOPE.
build_system: api-node: tsc (ts-node for dev). web: Vite (npm run build = `tsc -b && vite build`). No migrations tool: schema changes ship as guarded idempotent raw-SQL + schema.prisma edits + `npx prisma generate` (NEVER prisma migrate / db push).
test_framework: NONE configured in api-node (no vitest/jest). web has NO lint/test script. The committed quality gate is a clean type-check/build.
build_command: api-node: `npx tsc --noEmit` (run in api-node). After schema.prisma edits also `npx prisma generate` in api-node. web: `npm run build` (run in web).
test_command: No unit test runner. Gate = `npx tsc --noEmit` (api-node) + `npm run build` (web) both exit 0. Pure modules (generate/validate/completeness/dedupe/slug) are written DB-free so a future vitest can test them.
verification_instructions: 1) In api-node run `npx tsc --noEmit` — must be clean. 2) After editing prisma/schema.prisma run `npx prisma generate` in api-node — must succeed. 3) In web run `npm run build` — must pass tsc -b and vite build. 4) Do NOT start long-running servers. 5) seo-auto.sql is designed so a second apply is a no-op (guarded ADD COLUMN silently skipped; CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS prints 'already exists') — do not run it against a live DB in this flow; just ensure it is valid SQL following the prisma/seo.sql pattern.
snapshot_or_generated_files: `npx prisma generate` regenerates the Prisma client into node_modules/@prisma (not committed). No other generated/checked-in artifacts. There is NO prisma migrate.
environment_constraints: Work ONLY inside the worktree c:\xampp\htdocs\static4a\.worktrees\seo-auto-engine\4astore-v2 — relative paths from elsewhere land in the parent workspace. Branch is seo-auto-engine (do NOT push, do NOT open a PR). Integration branch is `main` (NOT `mainline`). Do NOT start servers. Grep tools exclude the .worktrees path — use Select-String / direct file reads for worktree files. google-services*.json files open in the editor are unrelated downloads — ignore them.
contribution_requirements: ADD-only, backward-compatible, break nothing. Preserve all commerce (checkout, UPI, customer login, delivery tracking, mobile app compat, existing product/category/order data and endpoints). Reuse existing auth (requireAuth + requireStaff). New /api/admin/seo-auto/* endpoints use requireStaff('settings'); in-place override writes folded into POST /products and POST /categories KEEP those routes' existing 'products'/'categories' permissions (do NOT add a 'settings' check there). Secrets (GSC/GA4/GBP) live in env or a git-ignored config server-side ONLY — never in the client bundle, never committed, never returned by any endpoint. Feature-flag high-impact automation (seoAuto master kill-switch; PHASE-2 flags default OFF). Audit-log automatic changes; idempotent + retry + race-safe; backups + rollback for high-impact changes. Never fabricate prices/stock/ratings/reviews/claims/branches. INR currency. Hindi + English + transliterated (Hinglish) variants.
key_patterns: Guarded SQL: prisma/seo.sql uses an information_schema COUNT guard + PREPARE/EXECUTE/DEALLOCATE per ADD COLUMN; new tables use CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS (InnoDB utf8mb4) like dataImport.ensureNotificationTables(). DB-row job queue: video/queue.ts (jobs in MySQL, single in-process `running` guard = one job at a time, progress written to the row every ~3%, recoverQueue() marks interrupted jobs failed on start). Cron: reminderJob.ts (`cron.schedule('* * * * *', ...)`) and videoScheduler.ts (recoverQueue() is the FIRST line of startVideoScheduler()). Flags: utils/features.ts mergeFeatures seeds from DEFAULT_FEATURES and flips a key OFF only on an explicit stored `false` — so a new key must carry its OFF in DEFAULT_FEATURES itself (PHASE-2 keys = false; master seoAuto = true). Flags are stored in config.features (LONGTEXT) and written by POST /api/admin/features. Web isFeatureOn(features, key, def) takes a per-call default. SEO config lives in config.seo (LONGTEXT); mergeSeoConfig DROPS keys it does not explicitly copy, so defaultLang must be wired through defaultSeoConfig + mergeSeoConfig + seoSchema. OG routes come in HTML+image pairs per entity (routes/og.ts); reuse getOrRenderOg(cacheKey, opts). Latent bug to fix: localSeo.buildProductJsonLd hardcodes availability 'InStock' and ProductLike lacks in_stock. routes/seo.ts cache is ONE Map with keys 'sitemap' and 'robots' (clear BOTH). routes/admin.ts has a local slugify (extract to utils/slug.ts and reuse). server.ts mounts adminDataRouter BEFORE adminRouter (specific path first) and starts jobs in the app.listen callback.
